args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP` instead of the required banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), causing the nightly build's `tests/test_money.py` to fail (see FIN-212).

## Change
- Updated `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` when quantizing to cents.

## Testing
- CI run ci-0001 passed for commit 08d3cd5986.
